description: This file defines the 'NotRequired' validation rule as part of the API v2 validator rules within the OrangeHRM Core plugin. It implements logic to determine if an input is considered 'not required' based on configuration, utilizing traits for helper methods.

classes.name: NotRequired
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is considered 'not required', with optional exclusion of empty strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes whether empty strings should be excluded when validating.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to determine if the input should be considered 'not required' based on the configuration.
